info.title: OpenJev API
info.description: Typed decisions — Choice, Score, and Noul — with calibrated confidence. One POST returns a typed answer per question over a shared state; no text generated.

tags.name: Decisions
tags.description: Execute typed decisions over a shared state.

bearerAuth.description: API key (ots_live_…) from /keys. Omit or send 'anon' for self-hosted anonymous use.

ChoiceQuestion.description: Classify the state into exactly one of the labelled options.

instructions.description: The question. Backtick-wrap state keys to reference them, e.g. 'Intent of `ticket`?'.

criteria.description: Map of label key → description. Keys become the valid output labels (2–255 entries).

abstain.description: Opt into abstention: when the input is out of scope or confidence is below abstain_below, the answer comes back with abstained: true (choice answers pick the reserved __none__ option).

abstain_below.description: Confidence floor for abstention. Implies abstain: true.

escalate_below.description: auto model only: escalate this question to the LLM when its local confidence is below this value.

ScoreQuestion.description: Rate the state on an ordered scale of 2–10 rubric levels.

criteria.description: Ordered array of level descriptions, from lowest to highest. The array index is the returned score value.

abstain.description: Opt into abstention: when the input is out of scope or confidence is below abstain_below, the answer comes back with abstained: true (choice answers pick the reserved __none__ option).

abstain_below.description: Confidence floor for abstention. Implies abstain: true.

escalate_below.description: auto model only: escalate this question to the LLM when its local confidence is below this value.

NoulQuestion.description: Return a calibrated P(yes) for a single yes/no proposition.

instructions.description: A yes/no proposition, e.g. 'Does `reply` leak PII?'

abstain.description: Opt into abstention: when the input is out of scope or confidence is below abstain_below, the answer comes back with abstained: true (choice answers pick the reserved __none__ option).

abstain_below.description: Confidence floor for abstention. Implies abstain: true.

escalate_below.description: auto model only: escalate this question to the LLM when its local confidence is below this value.

probabilities.description: Full distribution: every option key → probability. Sums to 1.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence for the winning label. Gate actions on this value.

ood.description: Out-of-scope score (distance of the state from the question vocabulary, modulated by answer entropy). >= 0.6 means out of scope.

abstained.description: Present and true when the model said 'I don't know' (abstention opted in).

p_none.description: Probability mass on 'none of the above / I don't know'.

calibrated.description: True when a customer calibration map rewrote this answer's confidence.

escalated.description: True when the auto model re-asked this question to an LLM.

score.description: The winning level index (matches the position in the criteria array).

legend.description: Map of level index → description, for display.

ood.description: Out-of-scope score (distance of the state from the question vocabulary, modulated by answer entropy). >= 0.6 means out of scope.

abstained.description: Present and true when the model said 'I don't know' (abstention opted in).

p_none.description: Probability mass on 'none of the above / I don't know'.

calibrated.description: True when a customer calibration map rewrote this answer's confidence.

escalated.description: True when the auto model re-asked this question to an LLM.

noul.description: Calibrated P(yes). Gate at your chosen threshold, e.g. > 0.7 for high-confidence yes.

ood.description: Out-of-scope score (distance of the state from the question vocabulary, modulated by answer entropy). >= 0.6 means out of scope.

abstained.description: Present and true when the model said 'I don't know' (abstention opted in).

p_none.description: Probability mass on 'none of the above / I don't know'.

calibrated.description: True when a customer calibration map rewrote this answer's confidence.

escalated.description: True when the auto model re-asked this question to an LLM.

model.description: Model id. Defaults to system-one (the always-on local engine). See GET /api/v1/status for which models are available on this deployment. `auto` is the cascade: local first, LLM only for low-confidence or out-of-scope questions.

state.description: The shared context for every question in this request. Can be a plain string, a structured object, or an array.

questions.description: Map of answer key → typed question. Each key becomes a matching key in the returned `answers` object.

escalate_below.description: auto model: request-wide escalation threshold (default 0.6 or OTS_AUTO_ESCALATE_BELOW).

calibration_id.description: Apply a calibration fitted on your labels (POST /api/v1/calibrations). Requires an authenticated caller.

model.description: The model id that produced this response.

answers.description: Map of answer key → typed answer. Keys match the `questions` map in the request.

input_tokens.description: Tokens consumed reading state and questions.

fallback.description: Present when the requested backend was unavailable and the local engine answered instead.

requested.description: The model id the caller asked for.

served.description: The model id that actually produced the answer.

escalation.description: auto model only: which questions escalated to the LLM and why.

type.description: Stable error type for programmatic handling.

used.description: Calls used in the current window (rate_limit only).

AuditReport.description: Signed calibration audit report. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON of every other field (keys sorted, no whitespace).

issuer.description: Public origin of the issuing server, when configured.

post.description: Submit a shared state and one or more typed questions. Returns a calibrated typed answer per question — Choice (label + full distribution), Score (level + distribution), or Noul (calibrated P(yes)). Multiple questions share one state read, so a 13-item checklist is one call.

state.ticket: My card was charged twice last Friday.

is_angry.instructions: Does `ticket` express anger or strong frustration?

400.description: Invalid request (missing fields, bad question shape, unknown model).

402.description: Allowance exceeded for this key (Railyard integration).

429.description: Rate limit or monthly quota exceeded.

get.description: Returns the API name, available model ids, supported primitives, and the wire-compatibility string. No auth required.

post.description: Execute multiple independent System One requests in a single HTTP call. Requests in the batch are evaluated in parallel; the response array preserves input order.

requests.description: System One requests to execute in parallel.

requests.state: This product is fantastic, arrived in two days.
Order still hasn't arrived after three weeks.

post.description: Dry-run validation for a System One payload. Returns any schema errors without executing a decision — useful for catching malformed questions before sending to production.

errors.description: Human-readable validation errors. Empty when valid is true.

post.description: Evaluate calibration quality (ECE, Brier score) over a labelled example set. Measures how well the model's confidence tracks observed accuracy on your data, so you can pick operating thresholds with confidence.

model.description: Model to evaluate. Defaults to system-one.

examples.description: Labelled examples: each has the System One request and the expected answer per key.

gold.description: Map of answer key → expected label / level / boolean.

accuracy.description: Fraction of top answers that matched gold.

ece.description: Expected calibration error (lower is better; 0 = perfectly calibrated).

brier.description: Mean Brier score over all questions (lower is better).

get.description: Returns health for every backend on this deployment — local (always available), native sidecar, neural (Laya MLX/ONNX), any-LLM, and OpenJev cloud — plus a per-model availability array. Not cached.

models.install: Start the neural sidecar (Laya). See SELF-HOSTING.md.

get.description: Lightweight liveness check. Returns API name, version, wire-compatibility info, active engine info, and the endpoint list.
Returns all API keys for the authenticated account. Full key values are never returned; only prefix and metadata.

post.description: Creates a new API key. The full key value (ots_live_…) is returned exactly once — store it securely. It cannot be retrieved again.

get.description: Returns token and call counts for the authenticated key, broken down by model and period.

get.summary: List calibrations, or get one with ?id=cal_...

post.summary: Fit a per-question calibration from your labelled examples
post.description: Each example is answered by `model` and graded against its labels; a temperature or isotonic map is fitted per question (10+ labels each; a pooled map covers the rest). Or pass eval_run_id to fit from an eval run. Apply with calibration_id on /api/v1/systemone.

labels.description: question id -> label: option key (choice), level index (score), boolean (noul)

201.description: The fitted calibration with maps, before/after ECE and Brier, threshold curve and recommended threshold

post.summary: Shadow your current LLM: answer the same questions and log agreement

incumbent.description: Your production LLM's answers. Omit `answers` to have this server ask its configured LLM chain instead.

200.description: Our answers, the incumbent's, and per-question agreement

400.description: Invalid input or no incumbent available

get.summary: Shadow dashboard: agreement overall, per question, per confidence band, and projected savings
Signed calibration audit report (HTML or JSON)
get.description: Bundles the per-question calibration map, raw vs calibrated accuracy / ECE / Brier, the recommended threshold, drift monitor and check history, 30-day shadow agreement and the report's limitations, signed with HMAC-SHA256. Team plan on the hosted service; included when self-hosted. Requires OPENJEV_REPORT_SIGNING_SECRET or BETTER_AUTH_SECRET on the server.

402.description: Plan does not include audit reports (plan_required)

503.description: Report signing is not configured on this server

post.description: Send the report JSON exactly as downloaded. Returns whether this server issued it and it is unmodified. No authentication required.

400.description: Body is not JSON or too large

503.description: Report signing is not configured on this server
